[EN] (It's an altar on which the Great Sword of Victory has been placed as an offering to Kaia.

The Great Sword of Victory was forged to commemorate the victory against the argons.)
[ES] (Es un altar en el que se ha colocado la Great Sword of Victory como ofrenda a Kaia.

La Great Sword of Victory fue forjada para conmemorar la victoria contra los argons.)
